method: Read the33page main-body text; inspect all33rendered pages in six contact sheets for page layout and figure context.
Compare stated objectives with named active Japanese paragraphs; distinguish an explanation from a merely related candidate.
Retain stable authored expression; restore four distinct paragraphs removed by overbroad deduplication.
Do not claim full-resolution label/table-cell recognition, complete atomic decomposition, or technical approval from contact sheets.
Record model/design/SDS/current-law requirements instead of universalizing numerical or operational source examples.
